sources.title: The Standard Model
supports: The Standard Model describes electromagnetic, weak and strong interactions.
Gravity is not part of the Standard Model.
A graviton has not been observed.
does_not_support: That QIK-VRT already supplies a complete quantum gravity theory.
That gravitational waves are graviton observations.

sources.title: The Higgs boson
supports: In quantum-field language a particle can be represented as a wave/excitation of a field.
The Higgs boson is an excitation of the Higgs field.
The 2012 discovery confirmed the Higgs field and Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism.
does_not_support: That the Higgs observation directly measures a graviton.
That field/excitation language alone derives Einstein gravity.

sources.title: Observation of a new particle in the search for the Standard Model Higgs boson with the ATLAS detector at the LHC
supports: ATLAS observed a new boson near 125 GeV in 2012.
does_not_support: A measured microscopic quantum of gravity.

sources.title: Observation of a new boson at a mass of 125 GeV with the CMS experiment at the LHC
supports: CMS independently observed a new boson near 125 GeV in 2012.
does_not_support: A complete measurement of the Higgs potential or quantum gravity.

sources.title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
supports: The first direct detection of gravitational waves was reported from GW150914.
The measured waveform agreed with general-relativistic binary-black-hole dynamics in the tested scope.
does_not_support: Direct detection of individual gravitons.
A complete ultraviolet quantum theory of gravity.

sources.title: Self-Interaction and Gauge Invariance
supports: Consistency and locality can generate the nonlinear Einstein self-interaction from a linear gauge-field starting point.
does_not_support: Uniqueness of an ultraviolet completion.
Empirical validation of the H5 bridge.

sources.title: General relativity as an effective field theory: The leading quantum corrections
supports: General relativity can be treated consistently as a low-energy quantum effective field theory.
Low-energy predictions do not supply the unknown high-energy completion.
does_not_support: A finished Planck-scale theory.
That any one proposed microscopic ontology is selected by low-energy EFT alone.

sources.title: A new topology for curved space-time which incorporates the causal, differential, and conformal structures
supports: Under stated spacetime conditions causal structure strongly constrains conformal and differential structure.
does_not_support: That an arbitrary repository relation reconstructs physical spacetime.

sources.title: The class of continuous timelike curves determines the topology of spacetime
supports: Timelike/causal structure determines substantial spacetime structure under explicit hypotheses.
does_not_support: An unconditional reconstruction from any finite causal data set.

sources.title: Space-time as a causal set
supports: Locally finite partial order is an established research proposal for fundamental causal structure.
Classical spacetime recovery is a separate approximation problem.
does_not_support: That QIK-VRT is identical to causal-set theory.
That a manifold limit has already been proved for H5.

sources.title: Quantum correlations with no causal order
supports: Quantum local operations can be modelled without presupposing a single definite global causal order.
Definite causal order reappears in the classical limit of that framework.
does_not_support: Usable signalling into an already recorded past.
That H5 physically realizes an indefinite-order process.

sources.title: Experimental superposition of orders of quantum gates
supports: A photonic experiment coherently controlled two gate orders and demonstrated an information-processing advantage.
does_not_support: Macroscopic retrocausal signalling.
A physical Big Bang in a computer.
